design.intent: Create an original RetroVault-owned Super Nintendo presentation that evokes the visual character of the 16-bit home-console era while remaining clean, game-focused, and suitable for long play sessions.
design.originality: The bezel composition, frame treatment, layout, materials, RetroVault branding, and presentation design must be original RetroVault work and must not reproduce third-party bezel artwork, console photography, or external pack artwork. Platform identification may include third-party trademark references when deliberately specified; ownership of those marks is not claimed by RetroVault.

composition.game_view: Centered transparent gameplay aperture with presentation framing that does not obscure gameplay. The aperture does not define the emulated game's display aspect ratio.
composition.frame: Purpose-built RetroVault frame with restrained early-1990s 16-bit home-console industrial character.
composition.surround: Dark neutral presentation field designed to keep visual attention on gameplay.
composition.depth: Subtle layered depth may be used around the game viewport without creating excessive visual bulk.
composition.branding: RetroVault is the primary presentation identity. Platform identification is secondary and remains visually subordinate to RetroVault and gameplay.

derivation.method: Scale the selected-master gameplay opening proportionally from the approved preview canvas to the canonical 1920x1080 RVV production canvas.

game_viewport.policy: This rectangle defines the transparent SNES overlay aperture only. It does not force the emulated game to fill or adopt the aperture aspect ratio. RetroArch and the active shader/presentation pipeline retain control of the intended 4:3 gameplay geometry.

safe_zone.policy: Final branding safe-zone geometry must be established from the accepted SNES master design. Branding must remain outside the transparent gameplay aperture.

runtime.game_aspect_policy: 4:3 is the intended presentation aspect for SNES gameplay. RetroArch and the active shader pipeline control final gameplay geometry independently inside the transparent overlay aperture.

branding_layout.policy: Exact SNES branding positions and accents remain design-pending until the SNES master visual is accepted. Gameplay must remain visually dominant.

finish.frame: Clean restored-console presentation with subtle material texture and restrained age character.
finish.controls: Any physical-console-inspired controls should appear maintained and clean but naturally used, with subtle wear appropriate to functional hardware.
finish.branding: Branding must be exceptionally crisp, precisely aligned, evenly spaced, and visually cleaner than surrounding functional details.
finish.consistency: The SNES visual must belong unmistakably to the RetroVault Classic family while retaining a system-specific early-1990s 16-bit identity.

master_visual_selection.family_direction: Preserve the established RetroVault Classic visual language and overall presentation relationship of the protected NES master while expressing the distinct industrial identity of the Super Nintendo generation.

housing.identity: SNES-console-inspired light gray and lavender molded-plastic presentation housing
housing.finish: premium restored-console finish with subtle texture, depth, seams, bevels, and restrained age character
housing.nes_relationship: Use the NES master as the family-level composition reference, not as literal SNES geometry.

gameplay_aperture.presentation: Large centered dark gameplay aperture remains the dominant visual element.

right_panel.replacement_direction: Console-derived architectural detailing using SNES-style venting, molded panel structure, restrained purple accents, and 16-bit hardware-era presentation.

lower_branding.selected_platform_mark: Super Nintendo Entertainment System bottom logo

controller.policy: No controller or joystick imagery is part of the selected SNES master visual direction.

master_visual_selection.production_boundary: This selection locks visual direction only. Exact viewport geometry, safe zones, production PNG, RetroArch descriptor, catalog registration, deployment, and production promotion remain pending.

catalog.attribution: Original RetroVault bezel composition. Platform names and trademarks are the property of their respective owners.

trademark_policy.ownership_claim: RetroVault claims ownership only of its original bezel composition, presentation design, and RetroVault branding.
trademark_policy.platform_identity: Nintendo platform identification is included as secondary system identification and is not claimed as RetroVault intellectual property.
trademark_policy.separation: Third-party platform identity must remain distinct from RetroVault branding and must not imply ownership of the third-party mark.
